meta.title: Entire-lot award option runs the auction at lot level
gaps: Directly assert that the live auction's bidding and ranking are aggregated for the entire lot rather than calculated per line item.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly assert that the live auction's bidding and ranking are aggregated for the entire lot rather than calculated per line item.

steps.note: Open the single-stage auction creation flow.
Select an auction with rank strategy and the entire-lot-to-one-vendor awarding mode.
Verify the create screen reflects the lot-level awarding configuration.
Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Add multiple line items so lot-level behavior can be exercised beyond a single-item case.
Invite a vendor so the auction can be published and bid on.
Assert that publishing reached a real project page.
Submit a live auction bid on behalf of the invited vendor.
Assert that the auction bid was accepted.
Open the buyer's live comparison view to inspect the auction ranking data.
Assert that the live auction exposes a valid rank based on the bid amount.
